lines.speaker: fence_moro
lines.text: Crew came through with a schedule. Numbers, no names, eleven stalls gone by Friday.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Let me see it. ...That is my article. That is the clause I wrote, cited as the authority, to do this.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I drafted a definition of custody so that a treaty could not be vague about who holds what. Somebody has used it to move people off a floor. I would like to go and be present while that happens, which I appreciate is not a plan.

choices.text: Every clause gets used like this.
